Lemma
[The Induced Tensor of a Non-Null Hypersurface is Nondegenerate]

↗ def:pseudo-pullback-form ↗ def:pseudo-normal-space ↗ prop:pseudo-riemannian-hypersurface-nondegenerate

Let $F:M o \widetilde M$ be a codimension-one immersion. If every nonzero normal is non-null, then $F^*\widetilde g$ is pointwise nondegenerate: for each $0 e v\in T_pM$, some $w\in T_pM$ satisfies $(F^*\widetilde g)_p(v,w) e 0$.
Proof

↗ def:pseudo-pullback-form ↗ prop:pseudo-riemannian-hypersurface-nondegenerate \sketch Proposition 17 makes the ambient restriction to $W=dF_p(T_pM)$ nondegenerate. For $u=dF_pv e 0$, choose $u'=dF_pw\in W$ with $\widetilde g(u,u') e 0$; Definition 17 gives the claim.

□
